scope: Read-only source readiness for one contained current native A-to-B EXIT case; no browser, test, service, build, or release was run.

candidate.eligibility: Recorded successful main-push CI development artifact, not Store eligible. The workflow requires the exact run and artifact IDs; the importer must verify GitHub metadata, source/receipt/tree, manifest version and development extension identity at execution. This inspection did not requery GitHub or reimport the artifact.

entrypoint: workflow_dispatch hosted-guest-acceptance.yml with the inputs above; hosted route runs tests/browser/showcase-picker-native-acceptance.mjs with MATRX_SHOWCASE_STALE_BOUNDARY=1

driver_readiness.source_comparison: git diff --name-only fa2720fc..HEAD shows no change to D42 picker product files, the D42 acceptance driver or its helpers; artifact package.json says 0.2.332. This is source comparison, not current native proof.
driver_readiness.selector_check: The current ListPatternTab renders Pick an example item, Picking on page…, Cancel, one selected field, Pick more fields and Extract. list-picker.ts creates data-scope-choice, .badge with N items, .picked-item, and #done/#cancel; the driver uses those selectors and the reviewed reachable card/field click helper. The prior D143 frozen 0.2.307 run passed all seven checkpoints with this driver lineage.

contained_native_assertions: On an owned /events fixture with three event cards, sign in as real admin and select the approved device organization; guest Showcase absence is also checked.

Start A, intercept the genuine overlay EXIT in the extension isolated world before Chrome delivery, cancel A in the side panel, then start B on the same page and require one overlay and B picking state.
Release A's captured EXIT through the original chrome.runtime.sendMessage; require a service-worker-stamped relay with A session/tab/document identity and require B still picking with one overlay.
Click a reachable B card, choose the three-card scope if offered, require a distinct B detection session and stamped relay on the same tab/document as A.
Click B's title field, Done, and Extract; require one selected field, three rows and all three fixture titles. Repick, cancel via overlay, then require an ordinary page click count of one.
coverage_limits: The current contained case holds and releases only A EXIT. The original D42 reproduction separately requires held A ITEM_DETECTED and RESULT after B starts; neither is covered.

B RESULT is checked through builder and extracted rows, and the diagnostic samples raw/stamped relay state, but the pass path does not explicitly assert the B RESULT relay session/tab/document identity.
Deferred A cancellation injection after B starts and deferred installation across replacement are not exercised.
Repick Cancel and ordinary clicking do not inject a second content context or count detection listeners; reinjection cleanup remains unverified.
The guest gate is checked, but nonadmin signed-in role gating is not exercised.
The frozen 0.2.307 D143 pass supports its own artifact only; no current 0.2.332 native D42 pass is claimed.
